title: Horrible chemical smell!!!
text:
Horrible chemical smell!!!. This would be a nice gift if I didn't have to replace with another brand for 3 people this Christmas!!! Gross chemical smell when you open the shrink wrap plastic!! Very strong. It's also not a good gift because it's all winkled so badly. It looks like a piece of paper someone balled up and then unwrapped!!
Really bad gift. You would have to wash it before you gave it and hope the detergent was strong enough to remove the smell. I don't think it would. Going back!!
